notes: Paired repeated stratified two-fold crossfit; folds identical across models. Repeats reuse queries and are dependent: split_repeat_std is split sensitivity, not a confidence interval. Checkpoints were selected on these internal queries; this is a conditional calibration diagnostic. Post-dev-unblinding exploratory design: prior seed17/18 dev results were already observed before defining this comparison. This script reads no dev data and fixes shrinkage at .5 without tuning it on this comparison; it is not a pre-dev preregistered confirmatory test.
